item.title: JavaScript Operator Precedence and Associativity: A Developer's Complete Guide
item.description: As JavaScript developers, we write expressions every day without thinking twice about how the JavaScript engine evaluates them. But understanding operator precedence and associativity is crucial for writing predictable, bug-free code and avoiding those head-scratching moments when your code doesn’t behave as expected.
